findings.fix: Restate with `variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {H : Type v} [CommRing H] [HopfAlgebra k H] [LocallyConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum H)]`, matching the prerequisite API; the finite-type case then follows from the existing Noetherian instance with no extra lemma.
findings.issue: All public results are stated for the bundled `H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u,v} k`, but finite type is used only at line 58 to produce `IsNoetherianRing H`, hence `LocallyConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum H)`. Nothing else in the file uses finiteness or the category packaging, so the statements are strictly stronger than the mathematics and cannot be applied to an unbundled commutative Hopf algebra.

findings.evidence: Lines 116-142 use only `h := homeomorphOfRingEquiv S.symm.toRingEquiv`, `hfix : h (augmentationPrime H) = augmentationPrime H`, and `eq_connectedComponentIdempotent_iff`; the antipode enters solely through `antipodeAlgEquiv_mem_augmentationPrime_iff` establishing `hfix`.
findings.fix: Prove the point-fixing-ring-equivalence lemma in `TauCeti/RingTheory/Idempotents/Connected/Component.lean` (where the definitions live) and derive both `antipode_connectedComponentIdempotent` and `map_connectedComponentIdeal_antipodeAlgHom` from it; `antipodeAlgEquiv_preimage_basicOpen` then disappears into the general lemma's proof.
findings.issue: `antipode_connectedComponentIdempotent` (and the supporting transport at lines 84-98, 116-142) proves a special case of a general commutative-algebra fact: if `e : R ≃+* R` satisfies `PrimeSpectrum.comap e x = x`, then `e (connectedComponentIdempotent x) = connectedComponentIdempotent x`, and consequently `Ideal.map e (connectedComponentIdeal x) = connectedComponentIdeal x`. The proof uses nothing about the antipode beyond it being a ring equivalence fixing the augmentation point.

findings.evidence: Mathlib's `AlgHom.convGroup` (`Mathlib/RingTheory/HopfAlgebra/Convolution.lean`) is declared under `[CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring A] [CommSemiring C] [Bialgebra R C] [HopfAlgebra R A]`, with `inv f := toConv (f.ofConv.comp (antipodeAlgHom R A))`; grep over `Mathlib/RingTheory/HopfAlgebra/` finds only `IsGroupLikeElem.antipode_antipode`, so no general version exists upstream.
findings.fix: State `antipode_antipode`/`antipodeAlgEquiv` publicly for `{R} [CommSemiring R] {A} [CommSemiring A] [HopfAlgebra R A]` in a Hopf-algebra file, and use it here.
findings.issue: `antipode_involutive` and `antipodeAlgEquiv` are stated `private` for a finite-type Hopf algebra over a field, but their proof (`inv_inv` in the convolution group on algebra maps) is valid for any commutative Hopf algebra over any commutative semiring. A general, reusable piece of Hopf-algebra API is being fixed at a needlessly special level and hidden.

summary: The results are stated for a bundled finite-type Hopf algebra over a field although finite type is used only to derive local connectedness of the spectrum, and two general facts (antipode involutivity; a point-fixing ring equivalence preserving the component idempotent) are proved privately at that special level instead of at their natural generality.
